sentences.en: This is my house.
It has a red door.
The window in the kitchen is open.
The wall in my room is white.
The floor is made of wood.
The cat is on the roof.
The stairs go up to the second floor.
I sleep in the bedroom.
We cook in the kitchen.
There is a garden at the back of the house.
I hear the bell at the door.
The rooms in this house are small.
Is there a bath in the bathroom?
He goes up the stairs to his room.
The oven in the kitchen is hot.
The owner of the house is my uncle.
sentences.zh: 房子的主人是我的叔叔。

sentences.en: The living room is the biggest room.
The base of the house is made of stone.
sentences.zh: 房子的地基是石头做的。

sentences.en: I wash my hands in the basin.
The condition of the old house was not good.
The connection between the two pipes was broken.
sentences.zh: 两根管子之间的连接断了。

sentences.en: The house temperature control was automatic.
sentences.zh: 房屋温度控制是自动的。
